sources.name: Panacea Lab · COVID-19 Twitter research collection
sources.attribution: Banda et al., A large-scale COVID-19 Twitter chatter dataset for open scientific research — an international collaboration. Epidemiologia 2021, 2(3), 315–324. doi:10.3390/epidemiologia2030024. Zenodo v160.
sources.license: Zenodo release metadata: other-pd (Other / Public Domain); use factual aggregate files only, no tweets or user profiles.
limitations: COVID-keyword research sample, not general Twitter trends or a platform census.
Top 100 valid canonical hashtags per daily file retained; absence is not zero.
Day from publisher filename; no subdaily observation time is asserted.
Early collection is selective and coverage has gaps.
Case/Unicode collisions retain the maximum, never sum potentially overlapping counts.

contexts.sampling: Top 100 canonical hashtags per publisher daily aggregate file. Date resolution only; UTC calendar bins are display intervals, not known snapshot times.

policy.deduplication: Deduplicate source record IDs. Normalize hashtag Unicode NFC and case only. Group by source context + UTC day + canonical hashtag. Keep highest displayed volume, never sum overlapping snapshots. Separate incompatible contexts.
policy.missing: No record means unknown. Subsets and daily maxima are explicitly described per context. Never fabricate zeroes, birthdays, ranks, or fill uncovered dates.
policy.time: UTC ISO-8601 intervals sorted by periodStart; original observation time retained where provided. Daily aggregates never masquerade as exact midnight sightings.
policy.scope: Single canonical file, multiple separately selectable measurement contexts. No blending of platforms, countries or incompatible metrics.
